profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs and sells consumer electronics, software, and services. Its own site describes Apple Intelligence as its next-generation AI system, integrated into iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27, with a stated focus on privacy at every step. The site describes Siri AI as a conversational assistant powered by Apple Intelligence, capable of open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth conversations, in-app actions across Messages, Music, and Reminders, writing assistance, on-screen visual queries, and web-referenced answers, with availability noted as coming in beta later this year and limited initially to English, and not initially available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.

The held facts list Apple Intelligence as an on-device large language model using Private Cloud Compute and Apple silicon with an emphasis on minimal data exposure, alongside Final Cut Pro AI and iMovie AI as on-device video editing products also built around Apple silicon and privacy. Apple reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025, on a 10-K filing, and trades on a public exchange under the ticker AAPL with CIK 0000320193.

Two MCP servers are registered in connection with Apple: one described as managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting in chat, listed under the name ai.b77/apple-search-ads, and one described as providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking for MCP clients, listed under com.apple-rag/mcp-server. No litigation is recorded in the held facts.
